StripView_Widget_Search_IsVisible.note: A focused rail only, not the preview: the preview keeps Strip's details positions, clear of the keypad.

search_preview_{index}.note: Reads the rail's probe (prb_search_preview), so readers test one cached flag, not the chain.

search_preview_live_{index}.note: The input has focus and this is the first rail with results; a reloading rail keeps its items, so the preview holds while it loads.

search_prior_clear_{index}.note: No rail before this one has results.

search_rails_updating.note: A key press reloads every rail: a rail still loading takes focus even if it ends empty, so the input waits for them.

search_container_switching.note: The focused rail was reached less than 0.5x ago (its latch, search_latches).
